name: Jade Shadows: Constellations
storyline:
Stalker names Jade's son either Sirius or Orion. Eternalism creates a timeline in which the unchosen son exists in a doomed future. Both Future Sirius & Orion arrive from twenty years later to the present with their mentors Ryoku and Vena in hopes of recruiting the Stalker for their own ends.

Hunhow, who had failed his children Natah and Erra, assists Stalker in breaking the son's warring feud. They recruit Excalibur Umbra, also a father who had lost his son, to their cause, while Stalker proceeds to incapacitate Ryoku and Vena to lure Sirius and Orion. Stalker then retrieves a Void Spark, which Hunhow uses to sacrifice his own memories to The Indifference in order to end the feud, creating a space where both options coexist.
summary:
A new and terrible education awaits on Venus…

The Jade Shadows: Constellations Quest continues Stalker’s story with an unlikely reality where both outcomes of a past decision are in an endless battle to prevail over the other. Step into this new cinematic Quest as the shadow and put a stop to this eternal conflict.

Come face to face with Sirius & Orion and their mentors. Orion is guided by Vena, Garuda’s Protoframe, the blood-drenched Wytch. Sirius is mentored by Ryoku, Ash’s Protoframe, the blade swarm assassin. Both sides vying to erase the other in order to secure their future.

Completing the Quest will unlock access to the Uranus Proxima, where you can play two new Railjack missions: Scoria’s Angel and The Kuva Wytch. Join either Vena or Ryoku with their own Railjack and crew in an epic hunt to take the other down. Completing these missions will reward you with new resources used to trade at a secret vendor in Pontis Tower, a new hub located in Uranus.

Wield the power of the stars with Sirius & Orion, our 65th Warframe. Two Warframes in one, in a constant duel for supremacy. They bring with them their signature Heavy Scythes, Pride and Wrath, each granting their own Melee buffs for Slam Attacks.

Embrace bloodlust with Vena’s Gemini Skin for Garuda or become a calculated killer with Ryoku’s Gemini Skin for Ash. Each comes with their own Gemini Emote showcasing these rivals' disposition and lethality.

Vena and Ryoku aren’t the only blade-proficient warriors in this update… Spears are also flying from Styanax Prime! Become the ultimate golden hoplite with Styanax Prime, Afentis Prime, Athodai Prime and his Prime Accessories with Styanax Prime Access.

The stars aligned and brought you even more to gaze upon in this update, Tenno! Knowledge glides on dark wings with the Dante Tytonis Collection. Railjack missions can now be played on The Steel Path difficulty. The Obex, Destreza, Stug, Ballistica, and Vectis Incarnons are also here. New Warframe Augment Mods for Dante, Nokko, Koumei and Temple have been added to Faction Syndicates. Nidus’ abilities have received a touch up and we’ve packed this update with loads of Quality of Life changes. And so much more to discover!

Thank you to Sumo Digital for co-developing the Railjack content, as well as the Vena & Ryoku cosmetic items in this update!
